collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

variants.text: A group of young Isolans is daring each other to jump off the rocks by the waterfall. (name1) is next in line, and everyone is watching.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) jumps, whooping all the way down, and comes up laughing. From then on (he/she) is the first one in the water every time.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) steps back from the edge. "Not today." A couple of the others tease (him/her), and one of them quietly steps back too.
